query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Shopify on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
briefing:
# Shopify Briefing: 16 October to 15 November 2026

**Meeting:** 17 November 2026. Attendees, purpose, your role, and business-unit or regional interests were not specified, so none are assumed.

## Coverage Summary

Two of the four categories have sourced activity in the window: news and product launches. Hires and leadership has one unverified lead, and no source URL was captured for it. Deals returned no qualifying activity.

## 1. News

- **Q3 2026 results (3 November 2026):** Revenue rose 32% (32% in constant currency), free cash flow margin was 22%, and GMV was $119 billion. [Shopify Investor Relations](https://shopifyinvestors.gcs-web.com)
- **Q4 2026 outlook:** Revenue growth is expected in the low-thirties percent range year over year. Gross profit dollars are expected to grow in the high-twenties. Operating expenses are guided to 29–30% of revenue, and stock-based compensation to $155 million. Free cash flow margin is expected to be consistent with Q4 2025. [Shopify Investor Relations](https://shopifyinvestors.gcs-web.com)
- **Filings (3 November 2026):** An 8-K, a 10-Q, and an S-3ASR are listed as dated 3 November. The 8-K's contents were not retrieved, so it is unknown whether it reports an officer or director change. [Shopify Investor Relations](https://shopifyinvestors.gcs-web.com)

## 2. Product Launches and Feature Releases

- **Fall '26 Edition:** Shopify's merchant announcement and the Editions page describe the release. [Shopify Editions Fall '26](https://www.shopify.com/editions/fall2026)
- **Agentic commerce:** A Shop skill lets ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents discover products and check out with Shop Pay. Shop Pay is also listed in Muse, Claude Duet, Instinct, and Grok Bot. Merchants can sell through Google Search AI Mode and the Gemini app. [Shopify Editions Fall '26](https://www.shopify.com/editions/fall2026)
- **Sidekick:** Shopify reports daily Sidekick sessions grew 4.2x year over year. Sidekick stages multi-step changes and applies them only after merchant approval. [Shopify Editions Fall '26](https://www.shopify.com/editions/fall2026)
- **Payments and international:** Shopify reports +50% higher international conversion for brands using Managed Markets, and lists Shopify Protect fraud and dispute tools. These are company-reported figures. [Shopify Editions Fall '26](https://www.shopify.com/editions/fall2026)
- **Developer deadlines:** Per a partner agency's review dated 11 November 2026, expiring offline access tokens become required for public apps on 1 January 2027. Shopify stops loading script tags on storefronts on 1 March 2027. Apps have been unable to create or update script tags since 1 October 2026. [Domaine review of Fall '26](https://domaineworldwide.com/de/einblicke/technologie/shopify-editions-fall-26-our-team-picks)
- **POS and retail:** Native stock counts in POS replace Quick Count, and HSA/FSA payments are accepted with Shop Pay. [Domaine review of Fall '26](https://domaineworldwide.com/de/einblicke/technologie/shopify-editions-fall-26-our-team-picks)

## 3. Hires and Leadership

No in-window appointment or departure was confirmed with a direct source URL.

One unverified lead needs checking before the meeting: a BetaKit report dated 19 October 2026 says CTO Mikhail Parakhin is moving to an advisory role, and Shopify has not named a successor. The source URL was not captured, so this is not stated as a fact.

## 4. Deals

No partnership, acquisition, investment, or major customer or vendor agreement dated within the window was found with a direct source URL.

## Three Open Questions

1. Q4 guidance calls for low-thirties revenue growth after 32% in Q3. What drives the expected slowdown, and which parts of the business does that outlook assume?
2. Offline access tokens become mandatory on 1 January 2027, and script tags stop loading on 1 March 2027. What support is Shopify providing to developers and merchants with older custom apps to complete these changes?
3. Shop skill and Shop Pay now let external agents such as ChatGPT and Claude complete checkout. How does Shopify think about brand ownership of the customer relationship and checkout data when a purchase happens inside an agent?

## Sources

[1] Shopify Investor Relations, Financials: https://shopifyinvestors.gcs-web.com
[2] Shopify Editions, Fall '26: https://www.shopify.com/editions/fall2026
[3] Domaine, "Shopify Editions Fall '26: The Features Our Experts Rate": https://domaineworldwide.com/de/einblicke/technologie/shopify-editions-fall-26-our-team-picks
